overview_description.description: Data Mechanics is a managed Spark platform for data scientists and engineers. The platform tunes the infrastructure parameters (e.g. CPU, Memory) and Spark configurations (e.g. parallelism, shuffle, I/O) automatically and continuously for every pipelines to make them stable and performant, and provide an easy-to-use serverless experience to its users.
